d: Throughout the seasons, several players have gone on to represent multiple PKL teams during their Pro Kabaddi journey. Players like Sandeep Narwal and K. Prapanjan have played for as many as six teams. These are some of the leading active players who have represented at least five Pro Kabaddi teams in their careers. For more videos like these, visit prokabaddi.com, our YouTube channel, or the Official Pro Kabaddi App!
